claim: GFDRR's investment in GeoNode yielded roughly 200% ROI in code terms versus a proprietary build costing \$2.0-3.0M.
quoted_support: the GeoNode software today represents an approximately 200% return on investment in terms of code written, since the current GeoNode project would most likely have cost \$2.0–3.0 million USD if GFDRR had produced it alone as proprietary software

claim: GeoNode became self-sustaining via an open-source community, letting GFDRR shift spending to country capacity building.
quoted_support: With GeoNode now a self-sustaining project, GFDRR is able to reap the ongoing benefits of its continuing software development while shouldering very little of the costs.
